intro: Trouble in the Valley centers on a mysterious squad of Kul Tiran soldiers discovered scouring the valley floor. Armed troops have set up camp near a wrecked caravan to the south, prompting local scouts to seek their elimination and uncover the purpose behind their unexpected search.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This morning I spotted a group of humans searching for something in the valley below. I managed to use my rifle's scope for a better look, and it was clear that they were soldiers sporting the livery of Kul Tiras.
If you'd be willing to take work from me, travel to where these soldiers made camp near the wrecked caravan to the south. Kill any you find and try to learn why they are here.
